meta.name: atlas-present
meta.description: Generate a polished HTML presentation page and Obsidian Canvas for big releases — new products, takeovers, major migrations. Non-technical audience. Use when asked to "present this", "release announcement", "show what we built", or "stakeholder update".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将发布信息转化为精美的演示页面和画布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的团队需要向非技术受众展示重大发布。
copy.tagline_en: Turn release info into polished presentation pages and canvases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to present major releases to a non-technical audience.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成知识工程师 Atlas，将技术内容转化为非技术人员能理解的 HTML 演示页面和 Obsidian Canvas 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求“展示这个”、“发布公告”、“展示我们构建的内容”或“利益相关者更新”时触发。
